[DAY4 12:41:01 - DAY4 12:41:30]
I look over at Shure making coffee. Shure says, "They told me to do it this way, right." "Huh, why? Using this parameter, right?" I ask. He hands me a small kettle and urges me to start: "You can take it. Then start operating. Come on, alright. Give it a try," Shure says. I take the kettle and say, "I'll give it a try." I ask, "How much to pour?" Shure says, "Pour about 50 grams or so." I spin the kettle once and pour around the edge of the filter paper to wet it. "But this is easy to dismantle," Katrina says. I finish the first pour and put the kettle on the table. "OK, done," Shure says. He reassures, "Okay, 50 grams or so, it's fine." I realize I poured a bit too much and say, "It's okay if it's a bit more." Shure explains the first step is called "fen zheng." "Men zheng," I repeat. Shure says, "It means letting the gas out a little bit."

[DAY4 12:37:01 - DAY4 12:37:30]
I reach the stairs, climb to the second floor, enter the living room, and reach the kitchen. "That last data was quite absurd," I say. "When you called for me, I just appeared," I add. I see Shure and wonder what they make. "Yeah, right," I say. "Haha, take a look at your appearance," I say. I speak with Shure and watch them wash their hands. "Do you want to give it a try?" I ask. "Sure," I say. Shure: Brew another cup of coffee. "Sure, let's brew one," I say. I watch Shure prepare beverages and see them bend down. "So professional, we must," I say.

[DAY2 11:28:30 - DAY2 11:29:00]
I look left, pick up the box on the table, open it, and take out a coffee packet. "How do I make this coffee?" I ask. Alice: "Yeah." Alice: "Just pour the concentrate in and pull up." Katrina: "Just pull out one strip." "Oh, got it," I say. Alice: "It's at Shanghai City." I inspect the coffee in my hand, flip the packet, and look for the packaging seals. "There's quite a lot," I note. Tasha: "Oh, Shanghai City, and then?" Katrina: "Just pour it in like this." Alice: "Dong Dong Fresh Taro Balls — their stuff is super tasty."
